svg.title: Ravi Rajjak PayNearby MarkTech and CRM showcase
svg.desc: Animated SVG showing Ravi Rajjak holding floating MarkTech and CRM circles with alternating floating rays on the left and PayNearby experience details on the right with animated fade in and fade out descriptions.

g.text: Mark
Tech
CRM
PAYNEARBY
Senior Engineering Team Lead
1. MarkTech
Growth, retailer engagement, onboarding and campaign experiences
• Built retailer referral and rewards journeys to boost engagement.
• Delivered retailer onboarding and campaign experiences.
• Referral features supported 200–400 retailer onboardings/month.
2. CRM
Complaint resolution, support flows and customer issue experience
• Built one-click complaints, reducing filing steps by 80%.
• Support automation helped cut open tickets by roughly 40%.
• Streamlined complaint tracking and issue-resolution flows.
Other Relevant Information
Leadership, platform engineering and mobile architecture impact
• Led and mentored 4–10 engineers on Android initiatives.
• Built a Spring Boot multilingual SDK, reducing APK size by ~10 MB.
• Delivered offline-first transactions using Room and WorkManager.
• Designed secure, scalable features for fintech and retailer apps.
Key strengths:
Android · Kotlin · Leadership · MarkTech · CRM · Platforms
